_about: Music for story videos: YouTube Audio Library tracks, 'Attribution not required', downloaded by the owner into a PRIVATE folder (STORY_MUSIC_DIR). Only names and settings are stored here; the audio is never committed (the library's terms forbid redistributing it). Checked 1 Nov 2026 with a voice detector: all instrumental except Gravel town shake, which has voice-like sounds in its first 28 s, so it starts at 30 s. Start points (measured 1 Nov 2026): where each track reaches its full body, so a Short never opens on a near-silent intro.
